literature.title: Parasitic skin diseases of dogs and cats.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: Myiasis 為蠅幼蟲寄生感染，Griseofulvin 作用於真菌微管蛋白，對節肢動物幼蟲無已知生物活性。機轉上無合理連結，TxGNN 高分（0.994）可能源於知識圖譜中「皮膚感染」節點的拓撲相似性，並非真實藥理關聯。
Creeping myiasis（皮膚爬行型蠅蛆病）屬於寄生蟲感染，Griseofulvin 無抗寄生蟲機轉。無任何臨床或文獻支持。
Wound myiasis 為傷口寄生蟲感染，Griseofulvin 對幼蟲無殺滅活性，無機轉連結，無臨床證據。
Furuncular myiasis（癤腫型蠅蛆病）與 Griseofulvin 無機轉連結，無任何臨床或文獻證據支持。
棘球蚴病（囊型包蟲病）為絛蟲感染，Griseofulvin 針對真菌微管蛋白之機轉無法延伸至蠕蟲。標準治療為 Albendazole/Mebendazole。無任何臨床或文獻支持。

literature.title: Cutaneous mycoses in children.
literature.abstract: This article describes common cutaneous mycoses in children: mucocutaneous candidiasis, pityriasis versicolor, tinea corporis, tinea pedis, onychomycosis and tinea capitis. Topical therapy is effective in tinea corporis and pedis, pityriasis versicolor and cutaneous candidiasis. It is ineffective in tinea capitis, in immunocompromised children and onychomycosis. literature.title: Common Skin Conditions in Children: Skin Infections.
literature.abstract: Skin infections account for a significant subset of dermatologic conditions of childhood. Common cutaneous viral infections in children include warts, molluscum contagiosum, hand-foot-and-mouth disease, and herpes simplex. Although viral infections are self-limited and often only mildly symptomatic, they can cause anxiety, embarrassment, and health care use. Recognition of their common and atypical presentations is necessary to differentiate them from other skin conditions of similar morphology.

literature.title: Terbinafine. An update of its use in superficial mycoses.
literature.abstract: Terbinafine is an allylamine antifungal agent which has fungicidal activity against a wide variety of dermatophytes, moulds and certain dimorphic fungi, and fungistatic activity against Candida albicans. Oral terbinafine 250 mg/day is effective in the treatment of superficial dermatophyte infections such as onychomycosis, tinea pedis and tinea corporis/cruris, generally achieving mycological cure in > 80% of patients. There are a large number of compounds belonging to different families of antifungals: polyens, azoles, allylamine and morpholine and antiseptic substances. literature.abstract: Onychomycosis is the most frequent cause of nail disease. literature.title: Common cutaneous manifestations and problems of diabetes mellitus.
Immune reconstitution inflammatory syndrome associated with dermatophytoses in two HIV-1 positive patients in rural Tanzania: a case report.
literature.abstract: Immune reconstitution inflammatory syndrome associated with dermatophytoses (tinea-IRIS) may cause considerable morbidity. Yet, it has been scarcely reported and is rarely considered in the differential diagnosis of HIV associated cutaneous lesions in Africa. If identified, it responds well to antifungals combined with steroids. We present two cases of suspected tinea-immune reconstitution inflammatory syndrome from a large HIV clinic in rural Tanzania.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 芽生菌病為深部真菌感染（Blastomyces dermatitidis），理論上 Griseofulvin 對真菌有微管蛋白抑制活性，然其對全身性真菌的藥物動力學不佳（穿透性差，血中濃度不足）。6篇文獻均為1963-1994年歷史綜述，在比較各種抗真菌藥時提及 Griseofulvin，但均指出其對全身性真菌療效不足，現代指引以 Itraconazole/Amphotericin B 為標準治療。文獻證據為歷史性間接負向證據。
Bacteroidaceae 為厭氧革蘭氏陰性菌，Griseofulvin 為抗真菌藥，對細菌無抗菌活性，機轉上完全不相關。無任何臨床或文獻支持。
